title: Focal Lengths
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculate the focal length of the lens and mirror.

title: Stages Identification
description: Important Criteria: Identify and describe the three stages of the optical system.

title: Image Distances
description: Essential Criteria: Accurately calculate the image distances for each stage.

title: Magnification Calculations
description: Important Criteria: Correctly compute the linear magnification for each stage.

title: Final Image Description
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the location and characteristics of the final image.

title: Sign Conventions
description: Pitfall Criteria: Misapply sign conventions for object and image distances.

title: Diagram Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: Include accurate diagrams for each stage of the optical system.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Make mistakes in units or fail to maintain consistency in calculations.
